description:
Changelog : v4.8.4 (76)\
• Rebuilt the interface with modern Jetpack Compose\
• Support for multiple Google accounts\
• User reviews on the app details screen\
• Optional app lock via biometrics or device credentials\
• One-click install for favourites and a buy flow for paid apps\
• Reworked notifications with grouped summaries and settings\
• Revamped updates screen; self-updates now shown in the list\
• More reliable downloads/installs and microG installer support\
• Bug fixes and translation updates
